name: Oh! Pai
source:
This game is an ultra simple version of Majong where you play with a selection of six girls. If you win, you get to improve your relationship with the girl.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402092638/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-m.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
该游戏是麻将的超简单版本，你可以与精选的六个女孩一起玩。如果你赢了，你和女孩的关系就会得到改善。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402092638/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-m.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
